a: Sample Game is an online co-op action RPG by Sample Studio. It entered Steam Early Access on May 7, 2026.

q: Is Sample Game free to play?
a: No. Sample Game is a paid Early Access title at $19.99 USD on Steam. There is no free-to-play tier and no demo.

q: Can I play Sample Game solo?
a: Yes. Every dungeon scales to party size and the game is fully completable solo, though duos are the most efficient.

q: Where can I find working Sample Game codes?
a: Our codes page is checked regularly and lists all currently active codes with their rewards.

q: Are Sample Game servers down right now?
a: Most of the time no — but during peak hours queues can appear. Check our live server status page for the latest report.

q: When is the Sample Game full release?
a: The developers have stated the game will remain in Early Access for approximately one year, so the 1.0 release is expected around mid-2027.
